description_en: Creates a subdirectory in Object Storage Service (OSS)
kebab_example: aliyun adb create-oss-sub-directory --path oss://testBucketName/das_lakehouse --db-cluster-id amv-bp149vz49b36t0000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateOssSubDirectory

parameters.help_en: The full OSS path of the directory to create
parameters.name: path

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The ID of the Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612397.html operation to query the information about all clusters in a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612397.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

ETag.description_en: The ETag of the OSS path

ServerCRC.description_en: The CRC-64 value of the Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code returned. A value of 200 indicates that the request was successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP请求返回的响应状态码，200表示请求发送成功

Message.description_en:
The additional information about the call result. Valid values:
If the request was successful, Success is returned.                                
If the request failed, a specific error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
调用结果的附加信息。取值说明：
请求正常，返回Success。                                
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功，取值说明：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
